title: Checkpointable Runbook Snapshot & Safe-Replay Assistant for Support Automation
creator: Priya Raman
description: Provide an operator-facing utility that captures discrete, auditable snapshots of a runbook execution (checkpoints) and a controlled safe-replay assistant that can re-run idempotent steps or fast-forward state for support engineers. Goal is to reduce time-to-resolution by enabling reproducible remediation, and to add an auditable trail for compliance-sensitive actions. This is not a wholesale replacement for full runbook orchestration; it is a light-weight adjunct to the runbooks-as-tasks model that fits into existing admin CLIs and the support console.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can create a named checkpoint at any step in a runbook and view a chronological list of checkpoints for that incident
Checkpoint snapshots include non-sensitive metadata (step id, timestamp, user, CLI flags, request id) and a hashed pointer to an immutable artifact stored in S3 or internal blobstore
Safe-replay assistant can re-run only whitelisted idempotent steps in a sandbox mode and requires explicit approval for any privileged step
All checkpoint create/replay actions are logged to the audit service with correlation IDs and surfaced in the Console incident timeline
Integration smoke tests for runbooks-as-tasks demonstrate end-to-end create/checkpoint/replay behavior with mocked infra and pass in CI
tasks: Design checkpoint data model and TTL/retention policy
Add CLI command: admin runbook checkpoint create/list/restore
Implement blobstore artifact capture (S3 + internal fallback) and hashing
Implement replay safety whitelist and approval workflow
Hook audit events into existing audit log pipeline
Console: incident timeline UI integration for checkpoint entries
End-to-end tests and CI job for checkpoint/replay flow
Run security review and update threat model for checkpoint artifacts
notes: Trade-offs considered: storing full environment vs hashed pointer to artifact to limit PII/exposure
We will default to redacting secrets (KMS-backed) and only retain operational metadata in index; if customers require deeper snapshots, provide opt-in encrypted archival
MVP: only support steps tagged 'idempotent' in the runbook DSL; non-idempotent steps require explicit approval path that creates a temporary admin task
This ticket intentionally avoids adding a new orchestration engine; it leverages existing runbooks-as-tasks executor and the admin CLI surface
Constrained scope reduces blast radius and accelerates ship; plan follow-ups for RBAC granular controls and cross-account replay
